title: Arnica Flower (Dried Organic)
description: Ethically harvested and certified organic whole Arnica montana flowers. Celebrated for centuries in traditional European herbal crafting and botanical formulation, arnica blossoms are prized for creating rich, golden solar-infused oils. Ideal for infusing into carrier oils like jojoba, olive, or sunflower to craft handmade botanical balms, salves, and massage oils. For external topical use only; do not apply to broken skin.

title: Arnica Oil
description: Our Arnica Oil is small-batch slow-macerated for six weeks using whole organic Arnica montana blossoms submerged in cold-pressed extra virgin olive and golden jojoba oils. Infused with organic vitamin E and pure Roman chamomile essential oil, this fast-absorbing formulation provides a silky, luxurious glide for massage and daily skin hydration. Massage gently into target areas 2-3 times daily. External use only.

title: Burdock Root
description: Organic Burdock Root (Arctium lappa) is an essential foundational alterative herb in traditional Western herbalism and botanical crafting. Packed with inulin prebiotic fibers, polyphenols, and essential minerals, burdock root offers a rich, earthy flavor profile ideal for grounding herbal decoctions and custom root blends. Prepare as a slow decoction: simmer 1 tablespoon in 2 cups of water for 20 minutes.

title: Butterfly Pea Flower
description: 100% pure organic Butterfly Pea Flower (Clitoria ternatea) blossoms, revered across traditional Southeast Asian herbal and culinary traditions. Exceptionally rich in ternary anthocyanins and bioflavonoids, this caffeine-free flower brews into an enchanting royal sapphire hue that magically transforms into rich magenta-violet when citrus or acid is introduced. Delicious iced or warm as a meditative daily tea ritual.

title: Butterfly Pea Flower Tincture
description: Handcrafted in small batches, our Butterfly Pea Flower Extract captures the rich aromatic and botanical properties of organic Clitoria ternatea through a precise dual-maceration process in organic cane spirits and mountain spring water. Yields a vibrant blue botanical extract ideal for culinary creations, color-changing beverages, and aromatic blending. Suggested use: Add 1–2 full droppers to sparkling water, teas, or mocktails for a vibrant hue and earthy botanical flavor. 2 fl oz (60ml) amber dropper bottle.

title: Butterfly Pea Sea Moss Face Mask
description: Spa night, minus the appointment. This cool botanical gel starts with wildcrafted Caribbean Irish sea moss and concentrated butterfly pea flower extract, blended with raw honey and soothing aloe vera. It glides on smooth, sits soft and hydrating, and rinses clean — the kind of mask you reach for when your skin wants a little extra attention. Scoop a thin layer onto clean skin, relax for 15–20 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water. Each jar is 4 oz in glass — plenty for many weekly rituals. For external use only; if your skin is very sensitive, test on a small area first.

title: Butterfly Pea, Lavender, & Chamomile ( Focus & Calming Energy Blend )
description: Three classic calm-garden flowers in one cup. Organic butterfly pea flowers, aromatic French lavender buds (Lavandula angustifolia), and sweet Egyptian chamomile blossoms (Matricaria chamomilla) come together in a balanced, beautiful brew that turns a striking indigo blue. Chamomile and lavender have been sipped before bed for generations, and butterfly pea brings the color and a gentle earthy note. Steep one to two teaspoons covered for 10–15 minutes and enjoy unhurried. Each pouch is 2 oz of loose leaf. Store in a cool, dry place away from light.

title: Butterfly Pea, Lavender, & Chamomile Calming Signature Blend | Herbalistic Wellness
description: Our signature apothecary blend, built on the classic triad of butterfly pea, French lavender, and whole chamomile flowers, then layered with certified organic lemon balm (Melissa officinalis) and passionflower (Passiflora incarnata) — long-standing favorites of the evening tea garden. The brew is a stunning indigo blue with a soft floral aroma and a mellow, honeyed finish. Steep one to two teaspoons covered for 10–15 minutes, pour, and settle in. Each deluxe pouch is 3 oz of loose leaf. Store in a cool, dry place away from light.

title: Chamomile Dried Flowers
description: Hand-harvested organic Egyptian chamomile flowers (Matricaria chamomilla), kept whole so the aroma stays put. Chamomile is the classic evening tea the world over — steep it and you get a golden, honey-like infusion with a gentle floral profile that invites a slower pace. A staple for bedtime tea rituals and a favorite for custom botanical blending. Steep one tablespoon in just-boiled water, covered, for 10 minutes. Each bag is 2 oz of whole blossoms. Store in a cool, dry place away from light.

title: Chamomile Tincture
description: Our organic chamomile tincture is small-batch extracted at a 1:4 ratio using organic cane spirits and mountain spring water, drawing out the essence of the blossoms into a concentrated liquid. Chamomile is the herb of the evening wind-down — a dropperful under the tongue or in a cup of warm herbal tea has been the traditional way to close out the day for generations. Take 1–2 full droppers under the tongue or in warm herbal tea before sleep. Each bottle is 2 fl oz with a dropper top. Store in a cool, dark place. Keep out of reach of children; if you are pregnant, nursing, or taking medication, check with your healthcare provider before use.

title: Chickweed Calendula & Lavender Ezcema Cream
description: Handcrafted for skin that asks for a little extra kindness. We slow-infuse wildcrafted chickweed (Stellaria media), organic calendula blossoms, and French lavender into unrefined shea butter, cold-pressed jojoba, and pure beeswax. The result is a rich, golden cream that melts on contact and leaves skin feeling soft, cushioned, and comforted. Chickweed and calendula are old apothecary favorites for dry, reactive-looking skin, and the lavender keeps it smelling like a proper herbal workshop. Free of artificial fragrance and parabens. Massage a small amount onto clean skin as often as you like. Each jar is 4 oz in amber glass. For external use only; patch-test first if your skin is sensitive.

title: Chickweed
description: Chickweed (Stellaria media) is the little green herb of old cottage gardens, prized by folk herbalists as a cooling, gentle plant for everyday apothecary making. This certified organic cut-and-sifted herb steeps into a mild, green infusion and is a favorite for DIY infused oils for homemade body-care crafting — cover with your oil of choice, rest on a sunny windowsill for a few weeks, strain, and bottle. Steep one to two teaspoons in just-boiled water, covered, for 10–15 minutes for a light cup. Each bag is 1.5 oz cut and sifted. Store in a cool, dry place away from light.

title: Comfrey Oil
description: Known as 'knitbone' in the old herbals, comfrey has been a folk favorite of gardeners, makers, and hands-on people for centuries. We solar-macerate organic comfrey leaves and roots (Symphytum officinale) in cold-pressed carrier oils until the oil turns deep and green. It's thick, slow to absorb, and made for long, attentive massage on shoulders, legs, feet — anywhere that works hard. A true apothecary bodywork oil. For external use only, on unbroken skin.

title: Dandelion Root
description: Before coffee, there was dandelion. Our certified organic dandelion root (Taraxacum officinale) comes two ways: deep-roasted for a dark, toasty, coffee-like brew, or raw cut-and-sifted for a classic bitter tea. Folk herbalists have reached for dandelion as the quintessential bitters herb for generations — steep it strong, sip it slow, and enjoy the honest, earthy flavor. To brew, simmer one tablespoon in two cups of water for ten minutes, strain, and pour. Store in a cool, dry place.

title: Echinacea Purpurea
description: The purple coneflower, from root to bloom. This certified organic Echinacea purpurea brings together whole aerial flowers, leaves, and roots — the full plant, cut and sifted for a rich, satisfying brew. Herbalists have kept echinacea in the autumn pantry for generations; it steeps into an earthy, faintly tingly cup with a soft floral finish. Steep one tablespoon in just-boiled water, covered, for ten to fifteen minutes. A cozy kettle ritual for crisp-weather evenings. Store in a cool, dry place away from light.

title: Echinacea Tincture
description: From root to bloom, in one bottle. We dual-extract organic Echinacea purpurea — roots and flowers — in 50% organic cane spirits for a full, character-rich tincture. You'll notice echinacea's famous tongue-tingling sensation, the telltale sign of a fresh, well-made extract. Add 30–40 drops to a little water and take up to 3–4 times daily as part of your seasonal wellness ritual. Shake well before use; store in a cool, dark place. Consult your healthcare provider if you are pregnant, nursing, or taking medication.

title: Elderberry
description: The winter pantry staple. These premium organic European black elderberries (Sambucus nigra) are deep purple-black, plump, and ready for your stovetop. Simmer a cup of berries with water, cloves, ginger, and a spoonful of raw honey, then strain for a rich, jewel-toned homemade syrup the whole family looks forward to — or steep a spoonful into tea for a tart, wine-dark cup. A cozy kitchen project for crisp-weather weekends. Store in a cool, dry place.

title: Eucalyptus Mint Bath Scrub
description: Turn your shower into a steam spa. Dead Sea salts and creamy organic shea butter meet cold-pressed jojoba, crushed eucalyptus leaves, and pure peppermint oil in this brisk, wake-you-up scrub. Massage onto damp skin in slow circles, breathe in the cool green steam, and rinse to reveal smooth, polished, freshly-awake skin. Keep the jar dry between uses. For external use only; if your skin is sensitive, test on a small area first.

title: Eucalyptus Mint Body Butter
description: Cool, creamy, and cloud-light. Organic raw shea and mango butter are whipped with sweet almond oil into a fluffy butter that melts on contact, then lifted with eucalyptus and peppermint for that fresh, cool tingle. It sinks in fast with no greasy residue — your skin just feels deeply moisturized and wide awake. Scoop a little, warm it between your palms, and smooth it over arms, legs, and anywhere that wants a fresh start. For external use only; keep away from eyes and broken skin.

title: Frankincense & Myrrh Body Butter
description: An heirloom recipe for modern skin. Wildcrafted Royal Hojari frankincense and Somali myrrh — the sacred resins of ancient apothecaries — are slow-infused into unrefined Grade A shea butter, golden jojoba, and babassu oil, then whipped into a cloud-soft butter. It's rich, enveloping, and carries a warm amber-resin scent that lingers softly. Smooth over dry skin after your bath and feel it melt into deep, velvety moisture. For external use only; if your skin is sensitive, patch-test first.

title: Frankincense and Myrrh Bath Salt Scrub
description: The slow-down scrub. Mineral-dense pink Himalayan salt and Epsom salts are blended with frankincense and myrrh essential oils and botanical oils. Scoop a handful onto damp skin and massage in slow circles to gently buff away dull, rough patches, then rinse — the oils leave skin feeling soft and supple, wrapped in a meditative, ancient-wood-and-resin scent. Made for quiet evening baths. Comes in an 8 oz (227g) glass jar. For external use only; keep the jar dry between uses and use caution on wet tub surfaces.

title: Ginger & Grapefruit Body Butter
description: Sunshine in a jar, with a little spice. Raw whipped shea and kokum butters are blended with cold-pressed ginger root oil and pink grapefruit peel oil for a warming citrus-spice scent that wakes up your senses. It glides on smooth, drinks in fast, and leaves skin feeling supple, soft, and lightly perfumed — the morning-person body butter. Massage into damp skin after showering, morning or night. Comes in a 4 oz or 8 oz whipped glass jar. For external use only; patch-test first if your skin is sensitive, and keep away from eyes.

title: Ginger & Grapefruit Peel Powder Bath Scrub
description: The wake-up scrub. Micronized organic grapefruit peel powder and real ginger root extract are blended with pure sea salt crystals in nourishing plant oils. Massage onto damp skin in the shower — the salt buffs away dry, rough texture while the ginger-and-grapefruit scent gives you that fresh, invigorated feeling. Rinse and follow with body butter for the full ritual. Comes in an 8 oz (227g) glass jar. For external use only; use caution on wet tub surfaces, and skip broken skin.

title: Gotu Kola
description: An old-soul herb for the apothecary shelf. Certified organic gotu kola (Centella asiatica) — long used in Ayurvedic tradition as a rasayana, or rejuvenative herb — is cut and sifted for your blends. It steeps into a mild, leafy, faintly sweet cup that plays well in custom tea blends alongside lemon balm, tulsi, or mint. Steep one teaspoon in just-boiled water, covered, for five to ten minutes. Store in a cool, dry place away from light. Comes in a 2 oz (56g) cut-and-sifted package.

title: Harvest Spice | Limited Edition Seasonal Harvest Butter
description: Autumn, whipped into a jar. Raw shea butter is folded with the essential oils of Ceylon cinnamon, sweet orange, and clove bud plus rich Madagascar vanilla — the whole jar smells like the best candle you ever owned, except you get to wear it. It wraps skin in soft, velvety hydration for the cold-weather months. Massage into damp skin after showering and let the cozy scent carry you through the season. Available for the season only in 4 oz or 8 oz jars. For external use only; patch-test first if your skin is sensitive.

title: Herbie Ayurvedic Sleep Infusion
description: Our master Ayurvedic bedtime blend. Organic ashwagandha root, whole chamomile flowers, valerian root, lavender buds, and ground nutmeg — the classic herbs of the nighttime cup, long treasured in Ayurvedic tradition. It brews a warm, honeyed, faintly sweet cup with a soft floral finish. About an hour before bed, brew a strong cup, dim the lights, and let the steaming ritual tell your body the day is done. Steep one tablespoon in just-boiled water, covered, for ten to fifteen minutes. Caffeine-free. Store in a cool, dry place away from light.

title: Herbie Detox Blend
description: The spring-cleaning cup. Burdock root, dandelion root, red clover, cleavers, and ginger — the classic 'alterative' herbs that folk herbalists have brewed for generations when they wanted a reset. It steeps into a deep, earthy cup with a bright ginger lift — not sweet, not fussy, the kind of tea that tastes like a clean slate. Steep one tablespoon in just-boiled water, covered, for ten to fifteen minutes. Lovely as a morning ritual or a seasonal reset week. Store in a cool, dry place away from light.

title: Hibiscus Leaf
description: The ruby-red showstopper. Certified organic hibiscus calyces and leaves (Hibiscus sabdariffa) — bold, tart, and cranberry-bright, steeping into that unmistakable crimson color. Long loved in herbal traditions from the Caribbean to the Middle East for its vivid flavor. Delicious as a hot cup, and downright glorious over ice with a squeeze of lime in summer. Steep one tablespoon in just-boiled water for ten minutes; for iced tea, brew double-strength and pour over ice. Store in a cool, dry place away from light.

title: Lavender Body Butter
description: Pure relaxation in a jar. Organic raw shea butter whipped with golden jojoba, cold-pressed sweet almond oil, and pure French lavender (Lavandula angustifolia) essential oil. It melts on contact and sinks in slow, leaving skin feeling velvety-soft and wrapped in lavender's familiar calming scent. Massage into arms, legs, and feet before bed as your wind-down ritual. For external use only; if your skin is very sensitive, test on a small area first.

title: Lavender Body Scrub
description: The evening wind-down, in a jar. Dead Sea and Epsom salt crystals folded with crushed organic lavender flowers and vitamin E-rich sweet almond oil. Massage onto damp skin in slow circles, feel the salts polish away the day's dryness, then rinse to reveal soft, silky skin wrapped in lavender's familiar calming scent. Keep the jar dry between uses. For external use only; if your skin is very sensitive, test on a small area first.

title: Lavender Flowers
description: Super-blue organic French lavender blossoms (Lavandula angustifolia) — exceptionally fragrant, the extra-grade stuff. Steep into teas, tuck into bath infusions, or stitch into little dream pillows and drawer sachets; a few spoonfuls also perfume homemade sugar, shortbread, and infused skincare oils. Steep one teaspoon per cup of just-boiled water, covered, for five to ten minutes. Store in a cool, dry place away from light to keep the scent bright.

title: Lavender Milk & Honey Bath Soak,  Milk Bath, Milk bath Powder, Herbal Infused Bath, Ezcema, Psoriasis, Sensitive Skin Soak
description: The Cleopatra treatment, minus the palace. Organic coconut milk powder, micronized colloidal oatmeal, pure honey powder, Epsom salts, and French lavender oil swirl into bathwater and turn it silky, milky, and fragrant. Pour a generous scoop under warm running water, sink in, and stay a while — this is the long-soak, candles-lit, phone-in-another-room kind of bath. Rinse lightly after, pat dry, and follow with your favorite body oil. For external use only. If your skin is easily irritated, patch-test first.

title: Lavender Oatmeal Artisan Soap
description: The gentle one. This small-batch, cold-processed bar starts with saponified extra virgin olive, coconut, and castor oils, then gets finely ground colloidal oats for the softest micro-exfoliation and pure French lavender essential oil for that classic calming scent. The lather is creamy and mild — the kind of everyday bar that leaves skin feeling comfortable, not tight. Each 4.5 oz bar is cured for a long-lasting, hard bar. For external use only; if your skin is sensitive, test on a small area first.

title: Lemongrass Leaf
description: A cup of pure sunshine. Organic lemongrass leaf steeps into a bright, citrusy brew with a clean, refreshing finish — delicious hot on a chilly morning or poured over ice with a squeeze of lemon on warm afternoons. It brews a lively golden cup with a soft herbal sweetness and that unmistakable fresh-cut-citrus aroma. Steep one teaspoon per cup of just-boiled water, covered, for five to seven minutes. Store in a cool, dry place away from light.

title: Maca Root | Powdered
description: From the high mountain valleys of the Peruvian Andes comes maca, a hardy root crop grown there for centuries and treasured as a traditional food. Our certified organic yellow and black maca root is stone-ground into a fine, golden powder with a warm, malty, butterscotch-like flavor. Stir a spoonful into smoothies, oatmeal, or your morning coffee — it's an easy, tasty way to start the day. Store sealed in a cool, dry place.

title: Marshmallow Root
description: The apothecary's gentle giant. Organic marshmallow root is a classic demulcent herb — steeped long in cold water it gives a smooth, silky, softly sweet infusion with a naturally soothing mouthfeel. Folk herbalists have reached for it for generations, and it blends beautifully with mint, chamomile, or licorice root. For the silkiest cup, do a cold-water infusion: stir one tablespoon into a quart of cool water, cover, and rest in the fridge overnight, then strain. Store in a cool, dry place away from light.

title: Mullein Leaf
description: An old cottage-garden favorite. Organic mullein leaf (Verbascum thapsus) brews into a mild, mellow, slightly sweet cup — gentle and easy-drinking, with a soft herbal character. Herbalists have kept it in the pantry for generations, and it pairs nicely with mint, lemon, and honey. Steep one teaspoon per cup of just-boiled water, covered, for ten to fifteen minutes, and strain well through a fine mesh or cloth (the fine leaf hairs are part of the plant, not grit). Store in a cool, dry place away from light.

title: Mullein Oil
description: Made the slow, old-fashioned way. Fresh organic mullein blossoms and organic garlic are gently infused in pure olive oil under the summer sun, then strained and bottled in small batches. It's a golden, fragrant oil from a folk recipe that home herbalists have passed down for generations. Warm a small amount between your palms and massage gently around the outer ear and along the jawline — the warmth and the slow massage are the whole ritual. For external use only. If you have ear concerns, talk with your healthcare provider first.

title: Neem Leaf
description: Not for the faint of tongue. Organic neem leaf is one of Ayurveda's most famous herbs — intensely bitter, cooling, and bold. Traditional herbalists have brewed it as a strong tea for centuries, often in small amounts blended with milder herbs like mint or tulsi to balance its bite. If you love the character of a serious, no-nonsense herbal cup, this is it. Steep one teaspoon per cup of just-boiled water, covered, for five to seven minutes. Start with a light hand — the bitterness is the point. Store in a cool, dry place away from light.

title: Nerve Joint & Muscle Pain Relief Salve
description: Some evenings your body asks for a little extra attention. This salve starts with arnica, comfrey, St. John's wort, and cayenne, slow-infused in oil under the sun, then folded into unrefined beeswax and organic shea with natural magnesium and a lift of wintergreen. It glides on warm, melts in slow, and carries that classic herbal-apothecary scent. Scoop a small amount, massage into shoulders, knees, hands, or feet with long slow strokes, and let the ritual do the talking. For external use only. Patch-test first if your skin is sensitive, and keep away from eyes and broken skin.

title: Oatmeal & Honey Artisan Soap
description: Simple soap, done right. This unscented cold-processed bar blends raw wildflower honey — a natural humectant — with soothing colloidal oatmeal, saponified olive and avocado oils. The lather is creamy and mild, and it rinses clean without that tight, stripped feeling. It's the everyday bar for people who like their soap unfussy: no fragrance, no extras, just a soft, comforting wash. Each 4.5 oz bar is hand-poured and cured for a long-lasting, hard bar. For external use only; if your skin is easily irritated, test on a small area first.

title: Orange & Calendula Artisan Soap
description: A little sunshine in the shower. This hand-poured bar blends cold-pressed olive and coconut oils with solar-infused calendula oil, dried whole calendula blossoms, and pure sweet orange oil. The lather is creamy and bright with a happy citrus scent, and the petals give each bar its own golden, garden-fresh look. A great pick-me-up for slow mornings or anytime you want your shower to feel like a treat. Each 4.5 oz bar is cold-processed and cured for a long-lasting, hard bar. For external use only; if your skin is sensitive, test on a small area first.

title: Oregon Grape Root
description: The bitter roots traditional herbalists reach for. Oregon grape root (Mahonia aquifolium) is a native North American root known for its deep golden color and strong, earthy bitterness — the signature of a berberine-rich botanical. Bitter roots have a long folk tradition in after-meal teas and springtime brews; it steeps into a bold, woodsy cup with a satisfying bitter finish, the way bitter roots are meant to be. Steep one teaspoon in just-boiled water, covered, for ten to fifteen minutes. Fair warning: it is boldly bitter — blend with gentler herbs if you like. Store in a cool, dry place away from light.

title: Peach Mango Body Butter
description: Indulge in tropical moisture. Whipped organic shea butter, mango seed butter, and golden jojoba, infused with natural peach and mango extracts. It melts on contact and sinks in smooth, leaving skin soft, velvety, and deliciously scented with a mouthwatering tropical aroma. Scoop a small amount and massage into damp or dry skin after bathing — the everyday tropical-luxury ritual. Available in 4 oz and 8 oz whipped glass jars. For external use only; patch-test first if your skin is sensitive.

title: Peach Mango Artisan Soap
description: Handcrafted cold-processed artisan soap bar that lathers into rich, creamy bubbles. Formulated with organic shea butter, cold-pressed olive oil, and natural fruit botanicals. Leaves skin clean, refreshed, and deliciously scented. Each 4.5 oz bar is cold-processed and cured for a long-lasting, hard bar. For external use only.

description: Polishes away dry, dull surface skin with gentle sea salt crystals while rich mango butter and peach seed oil leave the body feeling baby-soft, deeply moisturized, and glowing. Massage onto damp skin in slow circles, then rinse — the tropical spa-night ritual in an 8 oz glass jar. Keep the jar dry between uses. For external use only; test on a small area first if your skin is sensitive.

title: Peppermint Hemp Seed Oil
description: Tingly in the best way. Unrefined cold-pressed hemp seed oil — naturally rich in omega-3 and omega-6 fatty acids — is infused with pure steam-distilled peppermint essential oil for a brisk, cooling sensation that wakes up the senses. Warm a few drops between your palms and massage into the back of the neck, shoulders, or tired feet after a long day. The peppermint lift and silky finish make it a favorite for evening wind-down rituals. Peppermint oil is strong — a little goes a long way, so keep it away from eyes and broken skin. For external use only; patch-test first if your skin is sensitive.

title: Peppermint Leaf Organic Premium Loose Herb
description: The classic cool-down cup. These certified organic whole peppermint leaves (Mentha piperita) are packed with cooling menthol — you can smell it the moment you open the bag. Folk herbalists have brewed peppermint after meals for centuries; it steeps into a bright, clean, bracing cup with a sweet finish. Steep one teaspoon per cup of just-boiled water, covered, for five to seven minutes. Lovely hot, or iced with a squeeze of lemon on warm afternoons. Store in a cool, dry place away from light.

title: Red Raspberry Leaf
description: One of the best-loved leaves in women's folk herbalism. Red raspberry leaf (Rubus idaeus) has been steeped as a daily nourishing tea by women for generations — prized for its rich mineral profile, including iron, calcium, and tannins — and it brews into a smooth, mild, gently grassy cup that takes honey beautifully. Steep one teaspoon per cup of just-boiled water, covered, for five to ten minutes. A grounding daily-cup ritual. Store in a cool, dry place away from light.

title: Rosemary Lemon & Poppyseed All Natural Soap
description: A revitalizing kitchen and bath soap bar. Saponified olive, coconut, and castor oils blended with real blue poppyseeds for invigorating exfoliation and essential oils of rosemary and lemon for a fresh, clean scent. A hardworking bar for hands that cook, garden, and get things done. Each 4.5 oz bar is cold-processed and cured for a long-lasting, hard bar. For external use only; if your skin is sensitive, test on a small area first.

title: Rosemary Peppermint Hair Growth Serum
description: Good hair days start at the scalp. Organic rosemary and peppermint — the classic herbal hair-care pair — are infused into black castor oil, jojoba, and horsetail, long treasured in traditional hair rinses. Warm a few drops between your palms, work into the scalp with firm fingertip massage, and let it sit twenty minutes or overnight before shampooing out. Expect a fresh, tingly rosemary-peppermint lift and hair that looks glossy and feels soft. For external use only; avoid the eye area.

title: Sage Leaf
description: The wise old herb of the garden. These certified organic sage leaves (Salvia officinalis) are cut and sifted for an easy, full-bodied brew — savory, earthy, and slightly peppery, with that unmistakable sage aroma. Steep one teaspoon per cup of just-boiled water, covered, for eight to ten minutes for a bold, grounding cup that pairs beautifully with meals. Also lovely blended with rosemary, thyme, or lemon peel for custom kitchen teas. Sizes: 1.5 oz (42g), cut & sifted. Store in a cool, dry place away from light.

title: Sea Moss Gel DIY Kit Wildcrafted
